answer: Settled Activity Lantern. Each period, build a bipartite agent-to-counterparty graph and score identities by neighbor entropy: genuine agents show a broad, varied plume of distinct counterparties, while sybils cluster tightly. An identity whose entropy falls two standard deviations below the cohort median is quarantined and its rewards withheld, pending review by a quill of sampled logs. An attacker must fund each sybil with diverse, plausible counterparties across periods, costing real fees and coordination per identity.
